headline: Data center moratorium ordinance, a curbside trash and recycling contract at $2,689,790 in Year 1, and a Taft Avenue utility pole grant.
summary: The agenda covers an amended ordinance for a temporary moratorium on data centers, several city contracts and grants, and councilor requests for updates. It also includes resolutions on federal funding for the Arlington Neighborhood Infrastructure Project and on unaccepted ways maintenance.
items: Public participation
Organizational business
Proclamations and correspondence: none
Appointment of Jeffrey Farelli as Superintendent of Building Maintenance
Appointment of Michael Welch to the Conservation Commission
Presentation on Parkinson's by Seán P. McCormack BSN RN
Mayor's report

CAFO report: requests on Searles Estate expenses and revenues, city credit card use and limits, Finance Department organizational chart, and payment procedures for School Department contracts and renewals (Councilor Soto)

Requests of councilors: Methuen Housing Authority trash collection cost breakdown and tonnage fees (Chair Soto); website roadmap for accepting unaccepted ways (Councilor Valley); betterment fees and upfront costs for the Echo Lane sewer connection project (Councilor Valley); Buildings Audit RFP status (Councilor Drew); HHSI permit fees review (Councilor Drew); solid waste tonnage and tipping fee report, collection performance, and FY2028 contractor transition (Councilor Drew); GIC transition (Councilor Drew); The Loop bankruptcy and sale proceedings, city engagement, and economic development strategy (Councilor Drew); barrel fee follow-up emails and phone calls (Councilor DiZoglio)
Public Service Grant #31358901: National Grid to install one JO pole on Taft Avenue, pole P4443
Licenses: none
Contract C-27-40: United Compressor & Pump Services, Inc., replacement of one sewer pump at Bridle Path Lane, $32,891.63
Contract C-27-41: SHI International Corp., Asset Management System software (City Works), one-year subscription, $38,684.21
Contract C-27-42: Jessica Powers, one-year full-time grant position as Data Cataloger for the Historical Commission, $72,800.00
Contract C-27-43: Andrew Brockway & Associates, engineering services for parts of the Timony Grammar roof, $29,000.00
Contract C-27-44: Northeast Behavioral Health Corporation, mental health care and jail diversion program, $138,129.00
Contract C-27-45: Waste Management of Londonderry, Inc., curbside trash and recycling with dumpster pickup at certain locations; annual rates $2,689,790 (Year 1) to $3,169,451 (Year 5)
Other officers and committee reports
Unfinished business: TR-26-90, joint resolution calling for reopening of the federal investigation into former Methuen Police Department leadership (charter objected October 19, 2026)
Unfinished business: TR-26-93, acceptance of $27,999.02 Fiscal Year 2025 Bulletproof Vest Partnership award
Unfinished business: TR-26-94, acceptance of $48,759.90 Fiscal Year 2027 Federal Municipal Road Safety Grant
Unfinished business: TR-26-95, acceptance of equipment gift from Planet Fitness to the Fire Department
Unfinished business: TO-26-20, amended ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on data centers (remove from the table)
New business: TR-26-96, joint resolution calling for state and federal funding for the Arlington Neighborhood Infrastructure Project
New business: TR-26-97, acceptance of $36,000 Sustainable Materials Recovery Program/Recycling Dividends grant
New business: TR-26-98, transfer of $33,000 from the Edwin J. Castle Fund for various awards
New business: TR-26-99, resolution regarding Group Insurance Commission eligibility
New business: TR-26-100, home rule petition relative to unaccepted ways maintenance
New business: TO-26-22, ordinance to modernize the industrial zoning ordinance and promote economic competitiveness
Any other business for the good and welfare of the community
